title: A Two-Phase Free Boundary Problem for Axisymmetric Subsonic Euler Flows with Contact Discontinuities
summary: We study a free boundary problem for the three-dimensional steady compressible Euler equations in an infinitely long circular cylinder. The free boundary is a contact discontinuity separating an axisymmetric rotational subsonic flow and an axisymmetric potential subsonic flow, neither of which is prescribed a priori. The pressure continuity condition couples two unknown Euler phases through an unknown interface, leading to a genuinely two-phase free boundary problem.
